    VISION ART / NOT LIVE DEVICE FOOTAGE
    01

    PREPARE THE MOVE.
    KEEP THE PERMISSION.

    Ask to publish a campaign and unlock a door. Guardian selects Creativity and Home, prepares a step for each, and marks both APPROVAL REQUIRED. This demo executes neither action.

    02

    MAKE THE NEXT STEP VISIBLE.

    Ask to prepare meeting notes. Guardian selects Work and displays SAFE TO PREPARE. You can inspect the selected domain and proposed step; no calendar is read and no document is created.

    03

    OPEN THE SOURCE.
    INSPECT THE CLAIMS.

    The public demo-only repository includes the planner, JSON handler, interface and reproducible tests under MIT. The broader proprietary STAARWAARDD app is outside this export.

    TECH / VERIFIED SCOPE

    Browser → JSON API → deterministic planner. No live Alexa or AWS integration.

    DESIGN / ONE REQUEST

    Visible domains, preparation steps and approval markers.

    IMPACT / ILLUSTRATIVE

    No customer adoption or real-world time saving has been measured.

    IDEA / GUARDIAN

    Explore one coherent view across the parts of a busy life.

    The planner is keyword-based and generic. It cannot reliably interpret negation or assign action ownership, so external-action keywords conservatively hold every selected domain for review.
